what: Synthetic calibration samples for lib/brief.estimate_tokens (Addendum M5-T3, Task 58, ruling Q58-2). Own text, no client material.
method: Each sample was printed once (twice for ar_plain and en_plain, identical results) as a tool result in a Claude Code session on the subscription (model claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-18); the added input of the next request was read back from that session's own transcript usage numbers (input + cache write + cache read of request n+1, minus request n's total and its output tokens), minus the per-call overhead measured with empty tool results (39, of which the empty-output notice is ~8: overhead 31).
status: provisional: re-check with count_tokens when the API resumes (Nov)

en_plain.max_ratio_why: fluent English prose is overcounted ~29 % since the Latin rate was raised for identifier-heavy English (paths, snake_case, shas): the safe direction for a cap

fit: least squares over five classes on `samples` (in-sample), +5 %; then (fu1, review b2db1e7 P2-1) Latin raised 0.333 -> 0.41 and digit 0.621 -> 0.645 because the held-out brief-shaped samples below were undercounted by 6-8 %. `held_out` samples are never part of the fit: they are checks.

brief_largest_b2db1e7.what: the largest-fixture brief exactly as b2db1e7 + patches 01-03 printed it (header ~1484)
brief_largest_b2db1e7.measured_by: measured by the reviewer via subscription transcript usage, 2026-10-19 (1,618 - 31 overhead, twice); reproduced by the fu1 session with the same method (1,618)

en_identifiers.what: synthetic path- and identifier-heavy English (paths, snake_case keys, ids, 12-hex shas, CLI flags)
en_identifiers.measured_by: the fu1 session (claude-opus-5-5, subscription), the same transcript-usage read-back, 2026-10-19, twice with identical deltas (1,432 - 31 overhead; empty calls 39, three times)

brief_largest_fu1.what: the largest-fixture brief after fu1 (estimate 1,483 with the raised rates), measured AFTER the rates were pinned: a validation the rates were not tuned on
brief_largest_fu1.measured_by: the fu1 session (claude-opus-5-5, subscription), the same transcript-usage read-back, 2026-10-19, twice with identical deltas (1,483 - 31 overhead)
